definition: Epitalon (Epithalon) (ET) is a linear synthetic peptide supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 2 pack sizes: 10 mg, 50 mg. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. Each kit contains 10 vials; minimum order quantity is 1 kit. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is Epitalon (Epithalon) tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: Each lot of Epitalon (Epithalon) is analysed by HPLC for purity and by mass spectrometry for identity. The lot-specific certificate of analysis reports the measured purity, retention time, molecular mass and appearance. Catalogue purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC).

faq.question: How should Epitalon (Epithalon) be stored?
faq.answer: Store the lyophilized powder at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture. After reconstitution, keep the solution at 2-8 °C and use it within the period stated in the lot certificate of analysis. Avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles. This product is for laboratory research use only.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for Epitalon (Epithalon)?
faq.answer: Epitalon (Epithalon) is available in 2 configurations: 10 mg, 50 mg. Each kit contains 10 vials. Minimum order quantity is 1 kit. Volume pricing applies to 10-49 kits and 50+ kits.
